steps.title: Seed and transfect HEK293 cells
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293 cells in a 6‑well plate at 3 × 10⁵ cells per well in 2 ml DMEM containing 10 % FBS; incubate 37 °C, humidified, 24 h until 70‑80 % confluent. Transfect each well with 2 µg plasmid (pcDNA3.1‑corin‑V5 or pcDNA3.1‑prothrombin‑V5) using 85 µl OPTI‑MEM and 6 µl Fugene as per the manufacturer’s protocol. Return plates to 37 °C for 2 days.

steps.title: Select stable transfectants
steps.instruction: Remove medium, wash wells once with 5 ml PBS, then add 1 ml trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 37 °C 1‑2 min. Verify >70 % cells detached; tap plate gently to achieve >90 % detachment. Neutralize trypsin with 1 ml fresh DMEM + 10 % FBS per well. Transfer cells to 100 mm dishes (2.2 × 10⁶ cells per dish) containing 10 ml DMEM + 10 % FBS + G418 (400 µg ml⁻¹). Replace medium every other day for 2 weeks without passaging; maintain resulting G418‑resistant population.

steps.title: Verify recombinant protein expression
steps.instruction: Seed stably transfected cells in a 6‑well plate at 3 × 10⁵ cells in 2 ml DMEM; incubate 37 °C for ~36 h until ~90 % confluent. Aspirate medium, wash once with 1 ml ice‑cold PBS (pre‑chilled on ice). Detach cells by flushing with 1 ml ice‑cold PBS using a pipette until all cells are in suspension, then transfer to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube. Centrifuge 900 × g, 4 °C, 5 min; discard supernatant. Lyse pellet in 50 µl cell‑lysis buffer (50 mM Tris‑base pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 1 % NP‑40, 1 % protease inhibitor) on ice 4 °C for 30 min, tapping every 5 min. Centrifuge lysate 16 200 × g, 4 °C, 10 min; collect 50 µl supernatant. Add 50 µl 2× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer containing 5 % β‑mercaptoethanol, heat 95 °C 5 min, then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and Western blot
steps.instruction: Load denatured samples onto a 4‑20 % Tris‑Glycine gel and run SDS‑PAGE at 160 V, room temperature, 1.5 h. Transfer proteins to a PVDF membrane in transfer buffer (25 mM Tris, 190 mM glycine, 20 % methanol) at 100 V, 4 °C, 1 h. Block membrane in 5 % non‑fat milk in TBST at 4 °C for 1 h. Incubate with HRP‑conjugated anti‑V5 antibody (1 : 5 000 in blocking buffer) at room temperature for 2 h (or at 4 °C overnight) followed by standard detection.

steps.title: Inhibit glucosidases with DNJ
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293 cells stably expressing corin or prothrombin in a 6‑well plate or 100 mm dish in DMEM + 10 % FBS (add G418 400 µg ml⁻¹ if desired). Grow to 70‑80 % confluence, then replace medium with fresh DMEM + 10 % FBS (optional G418 400 µg ml⁻¹) containing 2 mM 1‑deoxynojirimycin (DNJ). Incubate 37 °C for 24‑48 h. Harvest cells and/or conditioned medium for downstream glycoprotein analysis.

steps.title: Prepare buffers
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions as described: Cell‑lysis buffer – 50 mM Tris‑base (pH 8.0), 150 mM NaCl, 1 % Nonidet P‑40, 1 % protease inhibitor cocktail (vol/vol). SDS‑PAGE buffer – 25 mM Tris‑base, 250 mM glycine, 3.5 mM SDS. Western‑blot transfer buffer – 25 mM Tris‑base, 190 mM glycine, 20 % methanol (vol/vol). Blocking buffer – 5 % non‑fat milk in TBST (w/w).
